newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end slow range trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end slow range trade mixed.

text.p: Dec 26 - IMM currency futures barely edged upward late, most ended range trading mixed, little changed. Order flows stayed light in most pits, with no trend evident. March yen set new contract low at $0.008797 after dollar briefly hurdled 115.00. Friday's US weekly jobless claims seen off 5,000 at 346,000. Nov durable goods expected up 0.1 pct, off 0.5 pct ex-defense. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
